Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Ami Neta Hobo" came out first despite clear evidence from multiple sources indicating that "Hood of the Living Dead" was released earlier (August 30, 2005). The Planner failed to properly compare the years of release and misinterpreted the timeline, erroneously stating that 2018 (Ami Neta Hobo) was earlier than 2005 (Hood of the Living Dead). This mistake likely arose from a misjudgment during the analysis phase and normalization of dates.
